title: Gold Bar XL Cola Freeze Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Cola Freeze perfectly captures the classic taste of fizzy cola, blending the famous soda’s tangy caramel sweetness with a sensation like crushed ice. The refreshing exhale adds a bracing tickle to the timeless taste of cola, enhancing the nostalgic soda flavour with a fresh and cooling. Each kit contains a 2ml prefilled pod and an attached 10ml refill reservoir, both preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for a smooth and flavourful MTL experience. These refills are designed to pair seamlessly with the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit a simple, rechargeable vape device with a long-lasting 1200mAh battery. Each pod houses a built-in mesh coil for steady vapour and great flavour from start to finish. Once the e-liquid is used up, the entire pod and refill unit can be replaced with a fresh flavour from the Gold Bar XL range.
